cameras.name: CAM_ISO_Front_Zone
cameras.room: Visitor zone (lobby, reception, experience centre, boardroom, executive suite)

camera_notes: position / direction / up / quaternion are the exact Blender camera matrices converted to glTF axes (checked against the camera nodes in the GLB: <= 0.005 mm, <= 0.12 deg). Perspective cameras are level; the renders frame the view with a vertical lens shift (shift_y, fraction of the larger image side). In three.js: camera.fov = vfov for the window aspect (keep the horizontal fov of the render on landscape windows), then camera.setViewOffset(W, H, 0, -shift_y * max(W, H), W, H).

rooms.name: Entrance lobby
rooms.description: Security / visitor check-in desk in walnut facing the main gate; oak-slat brand wall with the three client logos and the tagline, lit by track spots. The existing stair is kept.
rooms.ceiling: exposed deck, linear pendants, brand-wall spots

rooms.name: Reception & visitor waiting
rooms.description: Fluted-oak reception counter with a terrazzo ledge and an accessible lower section; backlit logo plate on a fluted oak wall; waiting lounge (sofa, green armchairs, walnut table, wool rug) under a suspended oak slat raft with a brass halo pendant.
rooms.ceiling: oak slat raft, brass halo, linear pendant on the beam

rooms.name: Visitor passage
rooms.description: Links the reception with the experience centre and the guest WCs, so visitors never cross the office areas.

rooms.name: Guest WCs
rooms.description: Two guest WCs with vanities off the visitor passage.

rooms.name: Boardroom
rooms.description: 15 seats: 6.1 m walnut table with a power/data trough, black leather chairs, 86 in screen on an oak slat media wall, walnut acoustic slats, green felt rafts between the existing beams and linear pendants over the table.

rooms.name: Audit room
rooms.description: Meeting table (1500 x 900 mm) for 5 with tall document cabinets.

rooms.name: Experience centre
rooms.schedule_label: EXPERIENCE CENTRE brand story + collection gallery
rooms.description: Brand-story wall with the logos and tagline, four garment display bays with deep-green backs, brass rails and LED shelves, a mannequin plinth, a 'yarn to garment' touch table, a long terrazzo display counter and a digital totem. Track lights on the existing beams; glass to the boardroom and the fabric library.
rooms.ceiling: track lights fixed to the beams

rooms.name: Executive reception
rooms.description: PA desk and executive waiting on the executive link, oak herringbone floor.

rooms.name: Director
rooms.description: Director desk (1680 x 810 mm), credenza and two visitor chairs; glass front on the oak-lined executive corridor.

rooms.name: Managing Director
rooms.description: 2.1 m walnut desk with leather pad, cognac executive chair, walnut feature wall with the logo, lounge corner (sofa, armchair, coffee table, rug), oak slat raft with a halo pendant, oak herringbone floor.

rooms.name: Executive corridor
rooms.description: Glass-fronted, oak-lined corridor linking the executive reception with the Director and Managing Director; direct door from the executive suite to the boardroom.

rooms.name: Guest workspace
rooms.description: Six work seats at a 2130 x 1000 mm table with a 55 in display for visiting staff.

rooms.name: HR & admin
rooms.description: Four desks and a round meeting table; the room also opens to the reception for candidates and vendors.

rooms.name: Commercial & accounts
rooms.schedule_label: COMMERCIAL & ACCOUNTS finance suite: 12 desks + manager
rooms.description: Proposed revised concept: a finance suite behind privacy glass with 12 finance desks, the manager's desk facing the team, a document processing counter with scanner and printer, lockable records filing, a small finance discussion room and archive cabinets by the audit room. A clear corridor keeps the route to the washrooms and the prayer room outside the suite.

rooms.name: Merchandising
rooms.description: Proposed revised concept: 16 merchandiser desks, a sample hub with an inspection island, rolling sample rails, dress forms and a fitting mirror, a buyer review table with a 65 in screen, lockable sample storage, a trim and colour approval wall and a sample dispatch counter. The four ceiling AC positions are unchanged.

rooms.name: Staff corridor
rooms.description: Staff route from the lobby staff door to HR & admin and commercial & accounts.

rooms.name: CAD / technical design
rooms.description: Three CAD workstations, a large-format plotter, a layout / digitiser table and a brand-green felt pinboard for tech packs.

rooms.name: Fabric & trim library
rooms.schedule_label: FABRIC & TRIM LIBRARY fabric, colour, print, trims
rooms.description: Fabric, colour, print and trim library: shelving, low swatch shelving, a swatch / garment rail and a D65 colour booth.

rooms.name: 3D printing lab
rooms.description: Four enclosed 3D printers, a printer bench, a post-processing bench with sink and a desk.

rooms.name: Sample development
rooms.description: Pattern & cutting table (2440 x 1220 mm), two sample machine stations, dress forms and a steam station - an office-grade sample studio, not production.

rooms.name: Global Design Studio
rooms.schedule_label: GLOBAL DESIGN STUDIO (name as proposed in the master plan)
rooms.description: Creative workstations by the east windows, a 7.4 m mood-board wall, trend table, collection display and buyer-presentation table with an 86 in screen. 'Global Design Studio' is the name proposed in the master plan.

rooms.name: Sample & material store
rooms.description: Store shelving for sample boxes and materials.

rooms.name: Design-wing corridor
rooms.description: Corridor through the design-development wing.

rooms.name: Staff cafe & pantry
rooms.description: 16 seats at two 2440 mm cafe tables and a 3660 mm pantry with sink and refrigerator.

rooms.name: Staff lounge / training
rooms.description: Multipurpose room: sofa group, 6-seat workshop table and screen.

rooms.name: North corridor
rooms.description: Circulation to the staff cafe, lounge / training and prayer rooms.

rooms.name: Hallway
rooms.description: Staff hallway between the workplace and the design wing.

rooms.name: Wudu (male)
rooms.description: Ablution room with a wudu bench next to the male prayer room.

rooms.name: Prayer room (female)
rooms.description: Separate prayer room with green prayer carpet, shoe rack and book shelf.

rooms.name: Wudu (female)
rooms.description: Ablution space with a wudu bench next to the female prayer room.

rooms.name: Washroom (female)
rooms.description: Two WC cubicles and a 1520 mm vanity.
